adminUsers.deleteAllSubscriptions: Delete all subscriptions of this user
adminUsers.deleteAllText: Cancel all subscriptions of {{name}} with the payment provider and delete them completely, including invoices? {{name}} will then be on Free. Payments will not be refunded.
adminUsers.deleteOneText: Cancel subscription #{{id}} ({{plan}}) of {{name}} with the payment provider and delete it completely, including invoices? Payments will not be refunded.

deleteRefusals.subscription_active: The account has an active subscription. First run “Delete all subscriptions of this user”, then try again.
deleteRefusals.last_group_admin: The account is the last admin of a group with other members. Assign another admin first.
deleteRefusals.paypal_unavailable: PayPal is currently unavailable. Try again later.
deleteRefusals.fallback: The account could not be deleted. Please try again.

adminUsers.reassign: Recalculate pillar distribution of all tasks
adminUsers.reassignIntent: Recalculate the pillar contributions of the tasks of ALL accounts based on title and description? Status, points and streak remain unchanged.
adminUsers.costsText: Each task is classified individually by AI — this uses quota and can take a while with many tasks. Tasks without a usable suggestion keep their current assignment.
adminUsers.lockText: Lock {{name}}'s access to the paid plan ({{plan}}) immediately? The lock takes effect immediately.
adminUsers.cancelText: Cancel {{name}}'s subscription ({{plan}}) with the payment provider? The plan continues until the end of the paid period.
adminUsers.deleteScope: Personal data and feedback will be removed. Invoices and subscription records are kept due to the retention obligation. This cannot be undone.
